subject: Novus RFP: contract QA — liability schedule, cap, and IP answers
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@novushealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novushealth.com>, Novus Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Novus RFP: Contract Questions (Liability cap / IP)

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking our RFP. We ran a legal pass on the contract questions and have a handful of areas we need clear, written positions on before moving to procurement review:

- Liability cap: please indicate whether Redwood proposes a cap tied to fees, a fixed USD cap, or a hybrid approach, and list any carve-outs (e.g., willful misconduct, breach of confidentiality, IP infringement).
- IP: can you confirm ownership of customer prompts and generated output? Do you assert any rights over model outputs?
- Indemnity: we need the standard vendor indemnity language and any limits on third-party IP claims.
- Order form and billing: confirm whether order form will include seat/throughput commitments and specify invoice cadence.

I've attached the contract questions spreadsheet — please send a redline or a response matrix by COB Friday if possible. Our legal team needs this for the next procurement committee.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Gomez
Procurement Manager, Novus Health
Attachment: Novus_RFP_Contract_Questions_v1.xlsx
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@novushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus RFP: Contract Questions (Liability cap / IP)

Hi Marta — thank you for the clear list. We're assembling a consolidated response and a redlined order form. High-level responses below; attached for your review will be a formal matrix and a proposed redline.

- Liability cap: Redwood's standard starting position is a cap equal to 12 months of fees invoiced under the applicable order form, with carve-outs for gross negligence/willful misconduct and breach of confidentiality. We can discuss tiered caps for enterprise commits.
- IP: Customers retain ownership of their input data and prompts. Redwood claims no ownership of customer-provided content. Generated model outputs are provided to customers under license; Redwood does not assert ownership over customer-specific outputs, subject to terms in Appendix A.
- Indemnity: Redwood provides indemnity for third-party IP infringement for software we deliver, subject to the usual notice and control requirements, and with liability limited by the cap above.
- Order form: we'll provide a redline including invoice cadence (monthly), payment terms net 45, and placeholders for committed throughput and burst allowances.

Attaching draft: Redwood_Response_Contract_Qs_2026-11-27.docx and redlines_order_form_2026-11-27.docx — Laura and Rishi, tagging you for legal final language and any suggested compromises. Marta, we can tighten cap language if you share your preferred alternative (USD fixed cap vs revenue-tied).

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Response_Contract_Qs_2026-11-27.docx; redlines_order_form_2026-11-27.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novus RFP: Contract Questions (Liability cap / IP)

Jasmine — quick legal review and proposed edits below (see attached AppendixA-IP-Indemnity-Text.pdf for final wording snippets). Key recommendations: 

1) Liability cap approach: propose a two-tier structure for enterprise deals: (a) Standard cap = lesser of (i) 12 months of actual fees paid in the prior 12 months or (ii) USD 2,000,000; (b) For customers committing to a 12+ month reserved capacity contract, offer an elevated cap equal to 18 months of fees or USD 5,000,000. Explain as an enterprise concession tied to committed revenue.

2) Carve-outs: maintain carve-outs for willful misconduct, gross negligence, breaches of confidentiality, and IP indemnity obligations. For IP indemnity, propose the indemnity covers direct damages from successful claims only; exclude consequential damages.

3) IP and outputs: adopt the following clear language: "Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and Customer Prompts. Redwood grants Customer a perpetual, royalty-free license to Model Outputs generated from Customer Data. Redwood asserts no ownership over Customer Data or Model Outputs." This avoids ambiguity while protecting Redwood's model IP.

4) Indemnity control: Redwood requires notice and an opportunity to defend/settle claims; Redwood will not accept carve-ins that expand indemnity to claims arising from customer's modifications or misuse.

5) Order form: recommend including a table of committed throughput (tokens/sec or qps), billing cadence, and a service-level credit schedule rather than dollar offsets. Keep payment terms net 45, with an early-pay discount optional.

I'll attach the suggested Appendix A text for legal so Jasmine can send clean language to Novus. If Novus pushes for an uncapped indemnity or higher cap, we should escalate to Sales leadership.

-Rishi
Counsel, Redwood Inference

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Final Redwood responses and redlined order form (Novus RFP)

Marta / Daniel — attaching our formal response matrix and a redlined order form. Summary of final positions: 

- Liability cap: Redwood proposes the two-tier structure (standard: lesser of 12 months fees or USD 2,000,000; upgraded for reserved/committed contracts: 18 months fees or USD 5,000,000). Carve-outs remain for willful misconduct, gross negligence, confidentiality breaches, and IP indemnity obligations.
- IP: Customer retains ownership of Customer Data and Prompts. Redwood grants a perpetual, royalty-free license to Model Outputs to the customer. Redwood does not claim ownership of customer outputs.
- Indemnity: Redwood will indemnify for third-party IP claims related to the software we supply, subject to notice and defense provisions and the liability cap.
- Order form / billing: Invoice cadence monthly; payment terms net 45. Order form includes committed throughput and an agreed burst allowance. We've included a proposed service credit schedule tied to latency and availability SLOs.

Attachments: Redwood_Response_Contract_Qs_2026-11-27.docx; redlines_order_form_2026-11-27.docx; AppendixA-IP-Indemnity-Text.pdf.

Please confirm receipt and let us know if you want to schedule a brief call to walk through the redlines. If Novus prefers a fixed-dollar cap instead of the fee-tied approach, indicate the USD amount you'd propose and we'll route for discount/upgrade concessions.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Marta
